pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

It means a greater deal than you know. I’ve been here through the entire stretch and you know I’m not going anywhere… why do I hold qi with passion even during my own hardships? I believe in each and every one of you. We’ve all done a part commenting. Sharing and liking raiding, etc. And I truly believe it will pay off in the end for all of you. Each of you play a role on why I’m still here. Joseph. Ghost. Successkid (not here) dread. Pxls. Xrpeace. Online, big boy, joxx, etc I could keep naming. It’s a great feeling knowing I’m apart of this community. And it’s been great talking and building with each of you. I’ve read and liked almost every thesis that has ever been written on this coin. And I know that’s a lot. I’m very good at observing my surroundings and I’m very aware. I know what we are capable of and I think time will only show that. Beyond that. Quantum security is going to be a huge narrative going forward. Quantum computing, physics, mechanics, cybersecurity; Will only grow in the coming year. It’s truly the last standing inu. Quantum based and coded. Nothing stands in the way of quantum taking over very soon. And I still see it being the lead of a bullrun. Liquidity. The trenches are struggling right now. Very low liquidity simply. Trade bots are another deal. The truth is. The trenches are dying very quickly. People are getting lazy and want quick profits. The true holders will prosper soon in my eyes and when I say that I think back to ghost and his story about Xrp. I go back and read that specific post sometimes because I like to see things from a different pov. And I am nowhere near the smartest in the room anywhere. I try to consume knowledge everywhere I can. And I think ghost and many others in here are great reads. And a lot to learn from everyone here. Stay blessed.
